Writes L into storage and into the\n// row-major panel buffer W (row stride NB, global row index).\n__global__ void potrfKernel(double* __restrict__ loc, int n, size_t lcol, int k0, int bs,\n                            double* __restrict__ W, int* __restrict__ info) {\n    __shared__ double s[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nth = blockDim.x;\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < bs * bs; idx += nth) {\n        const int c = idx / bs, r = idx % bs;\n        s[r][c] = loc[(lcol + c) * (size_t)n + k0 + r];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < bs; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double val = s[j][j];\n            if (val <= 0.0) atomicMin(info, k0 + j);\n            s[j][j] = sqrt(val);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double d = s[j][j];\n        for (int i = j + 1 + tid; i < bs; i += nth) s[i][j] = s[i][j] / d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int m = bs - j - 1;\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < m * m; idx += nth) {\n            const int i = j + 1 + idx / m;\n            const int c = j + 1 + idx % m;\n            if (c <= i) s[i][c] -= s[i][j] * s[c][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int idx = tid; k < n; ++k) {\n            const double v = bj[k];\n            s0 += b0[k] * v;\n            s1 += b1[k] * v;\n            s2 += b2[k] * v;\n            s3 += b3[k] * v;\n        }\n        out[0] = s0; out[1] = s1; out[2] = s2; out[3] = s3;\n    } else {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) {\n            const double* bi = B + (i0 + t) * n;\n            double s = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) s += bi[k] * bj[k];\n            out[t] = s;\n        }\n    }\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t)\n        if (i0 + t == j) out[t] += n;\n}\n\n// Generate the full symmetric positive definite matrix (row-major), as the original.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                                    const size_t n) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        double out[4];\n        for (size_t i = j; i < n; i += 4) {\n            const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(4, n - i);\n            dot4(B.data(), n, i, cnt, j, out);\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) {\n                A[(i + t) * n + j] = out[t];\n                A[j * n + i + t] = out[t];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate this rank's block columns (column-major, full height, lower part only).\nvoid generateLocalColumns(std::vector<double>& loc, const std::vector<double>& B, size_t n,\n                          int nt, int P, int rank) {\n    const int nlb = (nt - rank + P - 1) / P;\n    const size_t total = (size_t)std::max(nlb, 0) * NB;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t lc = 0; i < n; i += 4) {\n            const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(4, n - i);\n            dot4(B.data(), n, i, cnt, j, out);\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) loc[lc * n + i + t] = out[t];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (size_t i = 0; k <= j; ++k) sum += li[k] * lj[k];\n\n            const double e1 = fabs(sum - A_orig[i * n + j]);\n            const double e2 = fabs(sum - A_orig[j * n + i]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, std::max(e1, e2));\n            relError = std::max(relError, e1 / (fabs(A_orig[i * n + j]) + 1e-10));\n            relError = std::max(relError, e2 / (fabs(A_orig[j * n + i]) + 1e-10));\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Distributed GPU Cholesky. Each rank keeps its block columns resident on\n// its GPU (column-major, full height). A right-looking blocked algorithm with\n// one-step lookahead is used:\n//   - owner of block column k factors the diagonal tile (POTRF) and solves the\n//     panel below it (TRSM) on its GPU,\n//   - the panel is broadcast to all ranks (MPI, staged via pinned host memory),\n//   - every rank applies the rank-NB update (SYRK/GEMM) to its own trailing block\n//     columns on its GPU.\n// Rank 0 collects all panels (they are broadcast anyway) into the row-major result.\n// OpenMP is used for host-side work (matrix generation, result assembly, validation).\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                  \\\n    do {                                                                                  \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                        \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                        \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, \\\n                    __LINE__);                                                            \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\nconstexpr int NB = 64;             // block size (tile edge)\nconstexpr int TRSM_THREADS = 128;  // rows per TRSM thread block\nconstexpr int UPD_KC = 32;         // K-chunk in the update kernel\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Factor the bs x bs diagonal tile starting at global row/col k0, stored in local\n// column-major storage at local column lcol. Writes L into storage and into the\n// row-major panel buffer W (row stride NB, global row index).\n__global__ void potrfKernel(double* __restrict__ loc, int n, size_t lcol, int k0, int bs,\n                            double* __restrict__ W, int* __restrict__ info) {\n    __shared__ double s[NB][NB + 1];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nth = blockDim.x;\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < bs * bs; idx += nth) {\n        const int c = idx / bs, r = idx % bs;\n        s[r][c] = loc[(lcol + c) * (size_t)n + k0 + r];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < bs; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double val = s[j][j];\n            if (val <= 0.0) atomicMin(info, k0 + j);\n            s[j][j] = sqrt(val);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        const double d = s[j][j];\n        for (int i = j + 1 + tid; i < bs; i += nth) s[i][j] = s[i][j] / d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        const int m = bs - j - 1;\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < m * m; idx += nth) {\n            const int i = j + 1 + idx / m;\n            const int c = j + 1 + idx % m;\n            if (c <= i) s[i][c] -= s[i][j] * s[c][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < bs * bs; idx += nth) {\n        const int c = idx / bs, r = idx % bs;\n        loc[(lcol + c) * (size_t)n + k0 + r] = (c <= r) ? s[r][c] : 0.0;\n    }\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < bs * NB; idx += nth) {\n        const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n        W[(size_t)(k0 + r) * NB + c] = (c <= r && c < bs) ? s[r][c] : 0.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// Solve X * L_kk^T = A_ik for all rows below the diagonal tile (full NB width).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TRSM_THREADS)\ntrsmKernel(double* __restrict__ loc, int n, size_t lcol, int k0, double* __restrict__ W) {\n    __shared__ double Ls[NB][NB + 1];\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < NB * NB; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int r = idx / NB, c = idx % NB;\n        Ls[r][c] = W[(size_t)(k0 + r) * NB + c];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int i = k0 + NB + blockIdx.x * TRSM_THREADS + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= n) return;\n\n    double x[NB];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < NB; ++c) x[c] = loc[(lcol + c) * (size_t)n + i];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < NB; ++j) {\n        double s = x[j];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int m = 0; m < j; ++m) s -= x[m] * Ls[j][m];\n        x[j] = s / Ls[j][j];\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < NB; ++c) loc[(lcol + c) * (size_t)n + i] = x[c];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < NB; ++c) W[(size_t)i * NB + c] = x[c];\n}\n\n// Trailing update with panel k: for every local block column lb in [lb0, lb0+gridDim.y)\n// (global block column jb = lb*P + rank) and row tile ti >= jb:\n//   C(ti, jb) -= W(ti) * W(jb)^T\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(256)\nupdateKernel(double* __restrict__ loc, int n, const double* __restrict__ W, int k, int lb0,\n             int P, int rank) {\n    const int lb = lb0 + blockIdx.y;\n    const int jb = lb * P + rank;\n    const int ti = k + 1 + blockIdx.x;\n    if (ti < jb) return;\n\n    __shared__ double As[UPD_KC][NB + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[UPD_KC][NB + 1];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int tx = tid % 16, ty = tid / 16;\n    const int r0 = ti * NB;\n    const int c0 = jb * NB;\n\n    double acc[4][4];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a)\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) acc[a][b] = 0.0;\n\n    for (int q0 = 0; q0 < NB; q0 += UPD_KC) {\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < NB * UPD_KC; idx += 256) {\n            const int r = idx / UPD_KC, q = idx % UPD_KC;\n            As[q][r] = (r0 + r < n) ? b < 4; ++b) acc[a][b] = fma(av[a], bv[b], acc[a][b]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    const size_t lc0 = (size_t)lb * NB;\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int b = 0; b < 4; ++b) {\n        const int c = ty + 16 * b;\n        if (c0 + c >= n) continue;\n        double* col = loc + (lc0 + c) * (size_t)n + r0;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int a = 0; a < 4; ++a) {\n            const int r = tx + 16 * a;\n            if (r0 + r < n) col[r] -= acc[a][b];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Generate random matrix B exactly as the original benchmark does.\nstatic std::vector<double> generateB(const size_t n) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    return B;\n}\n\n// Compute A(i, j) = dot(B_i, B_j) (+ n on the diagonal) for 4 rows i0..i0+3 and column\n// j; each dot product is accumulated in the same order as the original code.\nstatic inline void dot4(const double* __restrict__ B, size_t n, size_t i0, size_t cnt, size_t j,\n                        double out[4]) {\n    const double* bj = B + j * n;\n    if (cnt == 4) {\n        const double* b0 = B + i0 * n;\n        const double* b1 = b0 + n;\n        const double* b2 = b1 + n;\n        const double* b3 = b2 + n;\n        double s0 = 0.0, s1 = 0.0, s2 = 0.0, s3 = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n            const double v = bj[k];\n            s0 += b0[k] * v;\n            s1 += b1[k] * v;\n            s2 += b2[k] * v;\n            s3 += b3[k] * v;\n        }\n        out[0] = s0; out[1] = s1; out[2] = s2; out[3] = s3;\n    } else {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) {\n            const double* bi = B + (i0 + t) * n;\n            double s = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) s += bi[k] * bj[k];\n            out[t] = s;\n        }\n    }\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t)\n        if (i0 + t == j) out[t] += n;\n}\n\n// Generate the full symmetric positive definite matrix (row-major), as the original.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                                    const size_t n) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        double out[4];\n        for (size_t i = j; i < n; i += 4) {\n            const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(4, n - i);\n            dot4(B.data(), n, i, cnt, j, out);\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) {\n                A[(i + t) * n + j] = out[t];\n                A[j * n + i + t] = out[t];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Generate this rank's block columns (column-major, full height, lower part only).\nvoid generateLocalColumns(std::vector<double>& loc, const std::vector<double>& B, size_t n,\n                          int nt, int P, int rank) {\n    const int nlb = (nt - rank + P - 1) / P;\n    const size_t total = (size_t)std::max(nlb, 0) * NB;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (size_t lc = 0; lc < total; ++lc) {\n        const size_t lb = lc / NB;\n        const size_t jb = lb * P + rank;\n        const size_t j = jb * NB + lc % NB;\n        if (j >= n) continue;\n        double out[4];\n        for (size_t i = jb * NB; i < n; i += 4) {\n            const size_t cnt = std::min<size_t>(4, n - i);\n            dot4(B.data(), n, i, cnt, j, out);\n            for (size_t t = 0; t < cnt; ++t) loc[lc * n + i + t] = out[t];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double* li = L.data() + i * n;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            // L is lower triangular: terms with k > j vanish\n            const double* lj = L.data() + j * n;\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k <= j; ++k) sum += li[k] * lj[k];\n\n            const double e1 = fabs(sum - A_orig[i * n + j]);\n            const double e2 = fabs(sum - A_orig[j * n + i]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, std::max(e1, e2));\n            relError = std::max(relError, e1 / (fabs(A_orig[i * n + j]) + 1e-10));\n            relError = std::max(relError, e2 / (fabs(A_orig[j * n + i]) + 1e-10));\n        }\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\n// Distributed GPU Cholesky. <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 1) / NB;\n    const int nlb = (nt - rank + P - 1) / P;\n    const size_t nlocCols = (size_t)std::max(nlb, 0) * NB;\n    auto owner = [&](int kb) { return kb % P; };\n    auto lcolOf = [&](int kb) { return (size_t)(kb / P) * NB; };\n\n    double* dLoc = nullptr;\n    double* dW[2];\n    double* hW[2];\n    int* dInfo;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dLoc, std::max<size_t>(nlocCols * n, 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dW[b], (size_t)nt * NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hW[b], (size_t)nt * NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dInfo, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dInfo, &n, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    cudaStream_t sMain, sCopy;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sMain, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreateWithFlags(&sCopy, cudaStreamNonBlocking));\n    cudaEvent_t evFact[2], evD2H[2], evH2D[2], evFree[2];\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFact[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evD2H[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evH2D[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evFree[b], cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    }\n\n    if (nlocCols > 0)\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dLoc, locHost, nlocCols * n * sizeof(double),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sMain));\n\n    // Factor panel kb (owner only): POTRF + TRSM, then stage panel to host.\n    auto factorPanel = [&](int kb) {\n        const int buf = kb & 1;\n        const int k0 = kb * NB;\n        const int bs = std::min(NB, n - k0);\n        const size_t lcol = lcolOf(kb);\n        potrfKernel<<<1, 256, 0, sMain>>>(dLoc, n, lcol, k0, bs, dW[buf], dInfo);\n        const int below = n - k0 - NB;\n        if (below > 0) {\n            trsmKernel<<<(below + TRSM_THREADS - 1) / TRSM_THREADS, TRSM_THREADS, 0, sMain>>>(\n                dLoc, n, lcol, k0, dW[buf]);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evFact[buf], sMain));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, evFact[buf], 0));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(hW[buf] + (size_t)k0 * NB, dW[buf] + (size_t)k0 * NB,\n                                   (size_t)(n - k0) * NB * sizeof(double),\n                                   cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, sCopy));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evD2H[buf], sCopy));\n    };\n\n    // Apply panel kb's update to local block columns lb in [lb0, lb1).\n    auto update = [&](int kb, int lb0, int lb1) {\n        if (lb1 <= lb0) return;\n        const int rowTiles = nt - (kb + 1);\n        if (rowTiles <= 0) return;\n        dim3 grid(rowTiles, lb1 - lb0);\n        updateKernel<<<grid, 256, 0, sMain>>>(dLoc, n, dW[kb & 1], kb, lb0, P, rank);\n    };\n    // First local block index whose global block index is >= g.\n    auto firstLocalAtLeast = [&](int g) {\n        if (g <= rank) return 0;\n        return (g - rank + P - 1) / P;\n    };\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < nt; ++k) {\n        const int cur = k & 1;\n        const int k0 = k * NB;\n        const bool isOwner = owner(k) == rank;\n        if (k == 0 && isOwner) factorPanel(0);\n\n        // Distribute panel k (rows k0..n-1)\n        const size_t off = (size_t)k0 * NB;\n        const size_t count = (size_t)(n - k0) * NB;\n        if (isOwner) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evD2H[cur]));\n        if (P > 1) {\n            if (!isOwner) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(evH2D[cur]));\n            MPI_Bcast(hW[cur] + off, (int)count, MPI_DOUBLE, owner(k), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n            if (!isOwner && k + 1 < nt) {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sCopy, evFree[cur], 0));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dW[cur] + off, hW[cur] + off, count * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sCopy));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evH2D[cur], sCopy));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamWaitEvent(sMain, evH2D[cur], 0));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Lookahead: update and factor the next panel first\n        if (k + 1 < nt && owner(k + 1) == rank) {\n            const int lbn = (k + 1) / P;\n            update(k, lbn, lbn + 1);\n            factorPanel(k + 1);\n        }\n        // Remaining trailing update\n        update(k, firstLocalAtLeast(k + 2), nlb);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(evFree[cur], sMain));\n\n        // Rank 0 assembles the row-major result while the GPU works\n        if (rank == 0) {\n            const int w = std::min(NB, n - k0) * NB;\n                double* d = A.data() + (size_t)i * n + k0;\n                const int lim = std::min(w, i - k0 + 1);\n                for (int c = 0; c < lim; ++c) d[c] = s[c];\n                for (int c = lim; c < w; ++c) d[c] = 0.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sMain));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(sCopy));\n    int info = n;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&info, dInfo, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    int ginfo = n;\n    MPI_Allreduce(&info, &ginfo, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    for (int b = 0; b < 2; ++b) {\n        cudaEventDestroy(evFact[b]);\n        cudaEventDestroy(evD2H[b]);\n        cudaEventDestroy(evH2D[b]);\n        cudaEventDestroy(evFree[b]);\n        cudaFree(dW[b]);\n        cudaFreeHost(hW[b]);\n    }\n    cudaStreamDestroy(sMain);\n    cudaStreamDestroy(sCopy);\n    cudaFree(dLoc);\n    cudaFree(dInfo);\n    return (size_t)ginfo;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int provided;\n    MPI_Init_thread(&argc, &argv, MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED, &provided);\n    int rank, P;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &P);\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n\n    // One GPU per rank (round-robin over node-local ranks)\n    {\n        MPI_Comm local;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &local);\n        int localRank;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(local, &localRank);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&local);\n        int ndev = 0;","numLines":160,"startLine":305,"totalLines":577}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfj8NnZbXcG9Rg8EQD2Pc","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cholesky benchmark now always runs as MPI + OpenMP + CUDA, and it passes `-v` validation on 1–4 ranks for every size I tried (n = 1, 5, 64, 100, 513, 1000, 2050, 3000). The output is bit-for-bit identical whatever the rank count. Only `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` changed, and the executable is still `cholesky`.\n\n**How it works**\n- **MPI:** the matrix is split into 64-column blocks dealt round-robin to the ranks, one GPU per rank. Each rank builds its own columns of the input matrix, so the input is never scattered.\n- **CUDA:** each step factors a 64×64 diagonal tile, solves the panel below it, and updates the remaining matrix, all with custom kernels. No cuBLAS or other new libraries.\n- **Overlap:** the next panel is factored on a high-priority stream while the current update runs.\n- **Moving panels between GPUs:** this OpenMPI build can't send GPU memory directly and the GPUs can't copy to each other. So within a node, the owning GPU copies each panel into shared host memory and the other GPUs on that node copy it from there. Between nodes, one rank per node forwards panels with `MPI_Bcast`. I tested that path by faking two nodes on this machine, not on a real cluster.\n- **OpenMP:** generating the input matrix, assembling the result on rank 0, and the `-v` check.\n- **CMake:** compiles `cholesky.cpp` as CUDA for sm_70/80/86/90 and links MPI, OpenMP and the CUDA runtime.\n\n**What's the same and what differs**\n- Same command-line options, same printed output (from rank 0 only), same exit codes.\n- The input matrix is bitwise identical to the original's.\n- Rank 0 ends up with the full lower-triangular result, upper part zeroed, before `print_results` and validation.\n- The factor matches the original only to rounding: relative error is about 1e-11 against the 1e-6 tolerance. The `-r` hash will therefore differ from the original program's.\n- If the matrix weren't positive definite, the GPU records the first bad diagonal index, and the program then prints the same error message and fails. This can't happen with the built-in generator, so that path is untested.\n\n**Timing:** the timer covers the upload to the GPU, the factorization, all communication and assembling the result on rank 0. One-time setup (GPU and shared-memory allocation, kernel warm-up) is outside it, just as the original allocates its matrix outside the timer.\n\n**Performance on the 4× RTX 3090 node** (run-to-run variation is roughly ±15%)\n\n| n | 1 GPU | 2 GPUs | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 8192 | 383 ms (478 GFLOPS) | 231–279 ms | 165–236 ms |\n| 16384 | 2485 ms (590 GFLOPS) | 1389–1490 ms | 734–906 ms (up to ~2.0 TFLOPS) |\n\nOne GPU runs at about the 3090's double-precision peak (~0.55–0.6 TFLOPS). At n=16384, 4 GPUs are about 2.7–3.4× faster than one. Gains are small at the default n=512 and level off toward the end of each run, where the remaining work per step is small.\n\n**Running it**\n- Use one rank per GPU, e.g. `mpirun -np 4 --bind-to none -x OMP_NUM_THREADS=64 ./cholesky -n 16384`.\n- Ranks share a node's GPUs round-robin.\n- Generating the input outside the timer is slow at large n (every rank builds the full random matrix), and so is `-v`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":225,"cache_read_input_tokens":120807,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":225},"output_tokens":753,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b58061fc-8780-4f8e-8d1c-940b101b939b","uuid":"b2e60e9d-4892-43bb-843b-14e291c9cfc8","timestamp":"2026-10-05T12:57:18.594Z","request_id":"req_011Cfj8NnF1DLvAtKxAbJxiU"}
